chunks.text: Been thinking about taking care of a couple things soon… I might be in Suzhou for a bit and I’ve been meaning to see a doctor there, depending on how my schedule shakes out.
And separately, I’ve also been daydreaming about a quick Xi'an trip—if it happens, I’d probably want to wander around some of the main attractions while I’m there.
If I end up doing the Suzhou thing, I was kind of considering an appointment with Shen Yuan, maybe the morning of 2026-04-29.
For that appointment, it would be under the name Sophia Garcia… assuming I actually follow through with it.
On the Xi'an side, I might swing by the Terracotta Warriors on 2026-03-21 in the afternoon—just 1 ticket, and it’d be for Emily Wang. Not sure if I’ll actually do this, we’ll see.
